the proposed cohort-projection-set is signed by root-fence, once per event (36 per migration). That gives the mutation-fence key a new, frequent attestation duty over Node-produced state it does not author, and pulls it onto the per-event path, while the set is fully derivable from the two Node-signed projections, the plan and the sequence. Producer, timing and key custody are unspecified
